quality of the job and the rights of the workers to advocate for the safety of workers and the public are also things the Unions have traditionally done. Boeing prospered tremendously when working with the unions in Washington state and it seems that a lot of their recent anti-union behavior is part of a number of decisions they've made that are quite short-sighted.
